text: This staff report is about a matter for which the Community Council has delegated authority from City Council to make a final decision. This report recommends the installation of no standing zones on both sides of Dowry Dowry Street, between Reidmount Avenue (west intersection) and the east end of Dowry Street. Currently, parking is permitted for a maximum period of three hours on both sides of Dowry Street, between Reidmount Avenue (West Intersection) and the east end of Dowry Street.
Scarborough Community Council: 1. Prohibited standing at all times on both sides of Dowry Street, between Reidmount Avenue (west intersection) and the east end of Dowry Street.
